summary: The Tilda slide and card carousel structures and Swiper tracks (.swiper > .swiper-wrapper > .swiper-slide) are normalized to editable layers. A generated tt_embed script handles arrows, bullets, keyboard input and slide swipes, horizontal card scrolling, or Swiper-like track snapping with disabled arrows at the ends. Swiper's initial layout is reproduced by classes and Embed CSS and was compared locally against Swiper 12.1.4; published-page behavior still needs a live check.
